method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Financial stocks fall with AI and flattening yield curve in focus
Equities.reason: Sector-level negative: flattening yield curve and bond-driven pressure hitting financials. Signals rotation away from cyclicals/financials into AI/tech, weighing on breadth — negative for financial sector and a modest drag on market risk sentiment.

Equities.title: The bond market is flashing a warning for stocks. These sectors are already wobbling.
Equities.reason: Macro negative for equities: bond-market signals (yields/curve) presented as a risk to equity sectors. High relevance because bond signals typically precede wider equity weakness and are already impacting vulnerable sectors.

Equities.title: AI Enthusiasm Drives Nasdaq 100 to First Record Since June
Equities.reason: Dominant market-positive narrative: renewed AI-led rally pushing Nasdaq to fresh highs. Strong market-regime signal — tech/AI leadership driving index returns and risk-on flows.

Equities.title: Nasdaq sets record high, oil dips on improved crude flows
Equities.reason: Market-positive: oil weakness reduces energy risk-premium and helps lift tech-led indices; reinforces the narrative of tech/AI leadership and rotation away from energy/financials.

Equities.title: Equities: Flat close with sector rotation – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists note that United States (US) equities finished virtually flat, as strength in technology and semiconductor stocks offset a sharp decline in financials.
Equities.reason: Descriptive note on intra-market rotation: overall index flat but clear rotation (tech up, financials down). Useful for interpreting breadth; limited market-moving relevance.

Equities.title: Asia stocks ride tech wave higher, oil slips again
Equities.reason: Regional confirmation of the global AI/tech leadership theme: Asian markets advancing on tech strength while oil weakness supports risk-on flows — reinforces cross-market tech leadership narrative.

Equities.title: Anthropic and OpenAI roll out cheaper models in first release since call for slowdown
Equities.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. Anthropic unveiled Claude Opus 5.5.
Equities.reason: Fundamental positive for AI sector and tech leadership: cheaper models lower adoption friction, supporting investor enthusiasm for AI-capable companies and reinforcing sector leadership in equities.

Equities.title: Stocks, Bonds Gain as Oil Extends Losing Streak: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Market wrap supporting positive near-term sentiment: simultaneous gains in equities and bonds amid lower oil suggest temporary easing of macro risk and supportive liquidity — modestly positive for equities.

Equities.title: Meta’s Muse Drags Down Stocks That Depend on ‘Consumer Inertia’
Equities.reason: Illustrates internal rotation within equities: new AI product is re-rating competitive dynamics, hurting legacy consumer names while boosting AI-adjacent stocks — supportive of the pro-AI leadership narrative.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the September 15-16 FOMC meeting
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the September 15-16 FOMC meeting
Rates.reason: The FOMC projections are a primary signal for the expected path of policy rates; a message that implies higher-for-longer policy or a slower disinflation path is negative for bond prices and pushes yields up. High relevance given direct, market-moving nature of SEP projections.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: The official FOMC statement frames near-term policy intent; a hawkish tone or emphasis on upside inflation/need for restraint is negative for bonds. High relevance as immediate guide to market rate expectations.

Rates.title: Fed’s Barkin Warns Inflation Pressures May Take Time to Pass
Rates.reason: A senior Fed official warning that inflation pressures are persistent supports the higher-for-longer narrative and keeps upward pressure on yields; direct Fed speaker risk to rates, moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Bank rate maintained at 3.75% - September 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: BoE maintained Bank Rate but the minutes/summary can convey persistence of restrictive stance or intent to keep rates elevated — modestly negative for gilts if signalling higher-for-longer.

Rates.title: Asset Purchase Facility: Gilt Sales – Market Notice 17 September 2026
Rates.summary: This Market Notice outlines the Bank Executive’s approach to implementing the Monetary Policy Committee’s (MPC) decision to unwind the gilts held for monetary policy purposes in the Asset Purchase Facility (APF). As part of this, Bank APF auctions will be paus
Rates.reason: Explicit guidance on APF gilt sales (QT) is a direct supply-side pressure on the gilt market and is clearly negative for bond prices (pushes yields higher). Very high relevance for UK rates.

Rates.title: Exchange of letters between the Governor and the Chancellor regarding QT and the APF - September 2026
Rates.summary: Exchange of letters between the Governor and the Chancellor
Rates.reason: Official correspondence confirming institutional agreement around QT/APF supports the gilt-supply narrative; negative for gilts but lower relevance than operational notices.

Rates.title: Change in the Guideline for Money Market Operations
Rates.reason: BOJ changes to money market operation guidelines can affect short-end liquidity and JGB yields; direction unclear from title but operational tweaks that imply withdrawal of accommodation are modestly negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: ECB wage tracker at 2.7% in H1 2027, pointing to a modest uptick in negotiated wage growth
Rates.reason: An uptick in negotiated wage growth supports stickier inflation expectations in the euro area, which is negative for European sovereign bonds as it raises the risk of higher policy rates.

Rates.title: Asia to Face Sustained Inflation Pressure Into 2027, ADB Warns
Rates.reason: Regional multilateral warning of sustained inflation implies continued central bank vigilance in Asia and upward pressure on regional yields; relevant for EM rates and global rate sentiment.

Rates.title: BNP’s Asset Unit Shorts China Rate Swaps to Hedge EM Bond Bets
Rates.reason: Market positioning (short China rate swaps) signals expectations of tighter Chinese rates or hedging against higher yields in EM bonds; informational for positioning risk in rates markets, lower relevance than policy moves.

Rates.title: IMF tells advanced economies to 'bring debt down' as borrowing costs rise
Rates.reason: IMF commentary that borrowing costs are rising underscores a structural higher-rate environment for advanced economies; broad macro signal that is negative for sovereign bond markets but relatively general.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index gains support amid hawkish Fed policy stance
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is gaining ground for the third consecutive day and trading around 100.70 during Asian hours on Wednesday.
FX.reason: DXY move is FX-native and signals broad USD strength driven by hawkish Fed expectations — dominant cross-market driver for FX flows. High relevance because it captures the overarching USD-dominant regime.

FX.title: Japanese Yen weakens further against US Dollar as hawkish Fed bets dominate
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) continues to underperform against the US Dollar (USD), with the USD/JPY pair trading 0.2% higher to near 157.70 during the European session on Wednesday. The pair trades higher due to continued outperformance by the US Dollar.
FX.reason: Major-currency move showing USD outperformance vs JPY; aligns with DXY/hawkish Fed narrative and matters for global FX positioning and carry flows. High but slightly below DXY relevance.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Hits fresh low since July 29, around 1.1425 as USD stays firm
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair remains under some selling pressure for the third straight day, touching a fresh low since July 29, around the 1.1425 region, during the Asian session on Wednesday.
FX.reason: EUR/USD weakness directly reflects USD strength; this is a price-forecast/technical piece so relevance is capped. Still useful as confirmation of the USD-dominant theme.

FX.title: Euro: De-escalation risk weighs on EUR against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen discusses EUR/USD in light of rising hopes for de-escalation in the Middle East. She notes the US Dollar (USD) has gained as rate expectations shifted in favor of the United States, with Euro Area inflation seen more energy-sensiti
FX.reason: Fund manager/bank note linking geopolitics and relative rate expectations to EUR underperformance vs USD. Relevant for EUR flows and fits the dominant USD-strength narrative; moderate-high relevance.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Downside still favoured toward 158.40 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann maintain a constructive short-term view on USD/JPY after the pair closed at 157.37. They still see scope for further US Dollar (USD) strength, with intraday moves expected within 157.10–157.90 and fir
FX.reason: Bank research reinforcing further USD/JPY upside — supports the wider USD-strength story. Institutional view is relevant but more tactical, so relevance is slightly below major-data items.

FX.title: British Pound weakens to near 1.3300 as UK fiscal deficit exceeds market expectations
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair attracts some sellers to around 1.3310 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The British Pound (GBP) weakens against the US dollar (USD) as the UK’s fiscal outlook has worsened, piling pressure on UK Chancellor John Healey ahea
FX.reason: Fundamental UK fiscal shock is a clear idiosyncratic driver of GBP weakness vs USD — material for GBP flows and risk positioning. Reinforces the USD-strength backdrop but partly domestic-driven, so high relevance.

FX.title: Australian Dollar slides to one-week low, below 0.7100 ahead of jobs data on Thursday
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair comes under heavy selling pressure on Wednesday and weakens further below the 0.7100 mark, hitting a one-week low during the early part of the European session.
FX.reason: AUD weakness against USD consistent with the broader USD-hawkish narrative; relevant given AUD's sensitivity to risk and commodity/US-rate moves. Domestic data event pending reduces persistency, so moderate relevance.

FX.title: Swiss Franc weakens as US Dollar rises on hawkish Fed sentiment
FX.summary: USD/CHF gains ground after four days of losses, trading around 0.8220 during Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains ground on the back of a hawkish policy outlook from the Federal Reserve (Fed).
FX.reason: CHF underperformance vs USD aligns with the central USD/hawkish Fed theme; material for safe-haven flows but less market-wide than DXY, so slightly lower relevance.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar declines to near 0.5700 on hawkish Fed remarks ahead US PMI data
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair declines to around 0.5710 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. Hawkish rhetoric from US Federal Reserve (Fed) officials regarding sticky US inflation provides some support to the US Dollar (USD) against the New Zealand Dollar
FX.reason: NZD down due to Fed rhetoric — confirms broad USD strength but is a smaller EM/commodity-linked currency move; relevance capped because it's a single-pair move with limited market-wide impact.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Eyes 1.4100 as bulls retain control near July 29 highs
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair prolongs its weekly uptrend for the third straight day, hitting a fresh high since July 29 during the early part of the European session on Wednesday. Bulls now await a move beyond the 1.4100 round figure before positioning for further gains a
FX.reason: USD/CAD technical/price-forecast article showing USD strength vs commodity-linked CAD. Price-forecast pieces are lower-relevance under framework, but it reinforces the USD-up theme.

FX.title: Forex Today: US Dollar continues to gather strength ahead of PMI data
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Wednesday, September 23:
FX.reason: Market-note/summary emphasizing prevailing USD momentum into PMIs; useful as situational overview of the USD-dominant intraday narrative. Moderately relevant for FX positioning.

FX.title: Eurozone flash Manufacturing PMI remains steady at 52.7 in September
FX.summary: Preliminary HCOB Manufacturing Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) in the Eurozone remains steady at 52.7 in September, while it was expected to drop to 52.6. The Composite PMI unexpectedly rises to 53.1 from 52.0 in August.
FX.reason: Euro-area PMI surprise offers some support to EUR vs USD, but impact is modest relative to the dominant Fed-rate-driven USD strength. Technical/soft-data relevance capped.

Commodities.title: Oil tanker costs hit record $1.2mn a day as Iran war disrupts shipping
Commodities.summary: Shortage of biggest supertankers has more than doubled rates on key Middle East-China routes since late August
Commodities.reason: Severe tanker shortage and sharply higher shipping rates act like a supply/disruption premium for crude deliveries on key routes — bullish for oil prices and risk premium in the physical market.

Commodities.title: WTI Oil hovers at two-week lows near $89.00 awaiting Middle East developments
Commodities.summary: Oil prices maintain their negative trend on Wednesday, with the price of the US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) barrel flatlining at the $89.00 area, its lowest level in nearly three weeks and 13% below last week’s highs.
Commodities.reason: Near-term price weakness in WTI driven by easing geopolitical risk and profit-taking; dominant market move is lower oil prices into the session.

Commodities.title: Brent: Price slide extends on pipeline restart – Danske Bank
Commodities.summary: Danske Research Team notes Brent crude trading near USD 98/bbl after six straight sessions of declines, with Oil acting as the dominant intraday driver for broader markets.
Commodities.reason: Pipeline restarts and signs of easing supply disruptions are removing risk premia, extending Brent’s decline — bearish for crude prices.

Commodities.title: Goldman Sees China Oil Imports Staying Subdued in Fourth Quarter
Commodities.reason: Goldman’s forecast of softer Chinese imports points to weaker demand fundamentals, an important bearish signal for the oil complex and price outlook.

Commodities.title: Corpus Christi LNG expansion makes facility the second-largest in the United States
Commodities.summary: On August 28, 2026, Cheniere Energy, Inc., completed its Corpus Christi Liquefaction Stage 3 Project (CCL Stage 3) in Texas, taking custody and control of the seventh and last liquefied natural gas (LNG) train in the project.
Commodities.reason: Additional liquefaction/export capacity increases long-run US LNG flows and sustains export demand for US natural gas — supportive for Henry Hub/US gas prices (structural demand-side tightening).

Commodities.title: Copper Retreats From Near Record as Traders Weigh Fed Outlook
Commodities.reason: Fed rate outlook and risk sentiment are cooling industrial-metal demand momentum; copper pullback reflects macro headwinds to cyclical commodity demand.

Commodities.title: What goes into diesel prices?
Commodities.summary: The price of distillate fuel oil, often sold as diesel, is driven by the price of crude oil, retail margins, distribution costs, taxes, and crack spreads, the indicator we use for refining margins. Tight global supplies of distillate fuel oil and elevated crud
Commodities.reason: EIA notes tight global distillate supplies and elevated refining margins — supportive for diesel and a positive cross-support for crude prices, especially on crack-spread strength.

Crypto.title: Binance probed by U.S. federal prosecutors for sanctions violations: Bloomberg
Crypto.reason: Major exchange under federal probe raises regulatory and counterparty risk for the crypto ecosystem; significant negative for market sentiment and liquidity.

Crypto.title: U.S. regulators rush to write crypto rulebook after Clarity Act stalls in Senate
Crypto.summary: State and federal regulators are rushing to fill the void after comprehensive crypto rules failed to clear the Senate.
Crypto.reason: Regulatory agencies stepping in to set rules increases the chance of clearer frameworks and institutional adoption — a net positive for crypto demand and market structure.

Crypto.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs attracted nearly $1 billion on Monday, the 9th largest inflow ever
Crypto.reason: Large ETF inflows are direct, high-impact demand into bitcoin; reinforces bullish institutional flow narrative and upward price pressure.

Crypto.title: Next for the U.S. SEC: Agency's chief crypto counsel illuminates path for custody
Crypto.reason: Signals from SEC on custody create clearer rails for institutions and product development — positive for market infrastructure and flows.

Crypto.title: Elon Musk's X brings crypto and stock trading via Coinbase, Kraken and Interactive Brokers partnership
Crypto.reason: Major platform integrating crypto trading broadens retail access and distribution channels — constructive for demand and adoption.

Crypto.title: Solana starts testing upgrade that could cut finality from 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds
Crypto.reason: Technical upgrade that materially improves throughput/finality supports ecosystem capability and developer interest — positive for altcoin fundamentals.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's on a streak it hasn't hit since 2012
Crypto.reason: Persistent bullish momentum in bitcoin amplifies investor risk appetite and reinforces ETF/inflow-led rally narrative.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin could test $90,000 after shorts get squeezed, but traders warn leverage is building
Crypto.reason: Rising leverage and concentrated short squeezes increase tail-risk for sharp corrections despite bullish price action — a moderating/negative signal.

Crypto.title: Canada's 'Big Six' banks to launch interbank tokenized deposit initiative
Crypto.reason: Major banks experimenting with tokenized deposits signals real-world institutional adoption of token rails and potential demand for related infrastructure.
